response.overview: Experience the Marvel Cinematic Universe: The Infinity Saga — an epic, feature-length journey spanning the first three phases of the MCU, from the birth of the Avengers to the ultimate battle against Thanos.  This massive fan-assembled edition combines all nine parts of The Infinity Saga into one continuous cinematic experience, bringing together the interconnected stories of Earth’s Mightiest Heroes and the cosmic forces that shape their universe.  Follow the journey from Tony Stark’s transformation into Iron Man, through the formation of the Avengers, the rise of new heroes, the fall of S.H.I.E.L.D., and the devastating events that lead to the Infinity War and Endgame.  Featuring an extensive collection of Marvel’s theatrical films, this edition brings together the complete Infinity Saga in one place, allowing you to experience the overarching story as one enormous movie.
response.tagline: Six Infinity Stones. Countless heroes. One ultimate destiny.
response.title: The Infinity Saga
